rules: Structured option encoding fields are compared as exact semantic facts; free-form text, substring matching, regex inference, and fuzzy matching are forbidden.
A complete structured option encoding must match exactly one admitted mapping or canonicalization fails closed.
If any structured option encoding field is null or unknown, canonical option encoding remains unresolved rather than fabricated.
Evidence for a canonical option encoding is the deterministic union of evidence attached to every asserted structured encoding leaf used by the mapping.
All non-option canonicalization behavior remains delegated to the source-locked v0 deterministic contract.
Canonicalization does not grant canonical-dataset or production admission.
